$instructions: Four staging categories mirror the official lesson material categories. Subfolders keep their stable IDs/links. Only verified official Drive placement plus publication status permits release.

generated_pdf.name: PDF-generated resources
generated_pdf.note: Teacher Guides only; generated companions belong under 04_TEACHER_RESOURCES/Other resources.

other.name: Other resources
other.note: External extras and generated teacher companions; verified files remain unpublished until official move.

slide_pdfs.name: Existing Slide PDFs holding folder
slide_pdfs.note: Existing separately reviewed Slide PDFs folder remains in its original location; do not move approved originals without explicit request.

published.note: Approved official folder IDs, recorded separately from the file's current location; missing baseline means NEEDS REVIEW. Slide decks require both main and PDF entries. Never auto-approve the folder from inspection results.
